stories.title: Number of Young People Out of Work and Education Falls Below One Million in the UK
stories.label: people
stories.summary: New figures out of the UK show that the number of young people who are not in work, school, or training has dropped below one million for the first time in a while. That's real progress for a country that's had one of the highest rates of disconnected youth in Europe. It means more young adults are building skills, earning a paycheck, or working toward a future career instead of feeling stuck. Small shifts like this tend to ripple outward, helping families and communities too.
stories.why_good: It reports an actual measured improvement in young people's economic prospects, based on new government figures, not a plan or forecast.

stories.title: Korean Drone Rescue Program Helps Mozambique Achieve Zero Fatalities During Worst Flood in Decades
stories.label: technology
stories.summary: Back in January, a community in northern Mozambique faced one of the worst floods the region has seen in decades. Thanks to a squadron of drones flown by trained pilots, rescue teams could see exactly where people were trapped and get help to them fast. The result: not a single life was lost in the flooding. It's a powerful example of how a relatively small, smart piece of technology can turn a natural disaster from a tragedy into a story of successful teamwork.
stories.why_good: A real disaster response that actually worked, with a verified zero-fatality outcome, thanks to a technology program that already happened rather than one still being planned.
